decisions.statement: A run begun inside a run has nothing of its own.
A value asked for outside every run is made afresh.
Nothing here names the values worth holding.
Loading this module reaches nothing of node and makes nothing.
What keeps runs apart is reached at the first ask and kept.
Where node is absent nothing is held and every value is made afresh.

definition: a value made once and held for as long as one run of a command lasts
